facts.fact: The Centre National de l'Informatique's page states that the national civil status system Madania manages all civil status documents, naming birth, marriage, divorce and death, publishes them at municipalities, municipal districts and commercial sites, and builds a centralised database (the page is undated; the document's published date, a proxy year, is used).

systems.country_label: MADANIA, the national civil status system
systems.owner: Centre National de l'Informatique (the page's publisher, under its project management services)
systems.tiers: municipalities, municipal counties and commercial sites; centralised database; documents issued online regardless of place of registration; number of sites not given

systems.system: Madania: electronic exchange with the national social security funds
systems.country_label: échange électronique des documents d'état civil avec les caisses de sécurité sociale

systems.tiers: a project whose objective is to let social security funds and educational institutions obtain civil status documents online

note: The page does not say how or when the record is made at the office, nor how many offices use the system.
